result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make it easier for people to understand each other deeply—not just to hear words, but to genuinely appreciate different experiences, pain, hopes, and perspectives.

Many of the world’s biggest problems—conflict, inequality, cruelty, neglect—are worsened by a failure of empathy. If people could more consistently recognize the humanity in others, I think societies would become more compassionate, more cooperative, and more willing to solve problems together.
